coarse-preview.name: coarse-preview
coarse-preview.description: Fast Gmsh tetrahedral mesh at a 5 mm target size, for a quick first look. Sizes are absolute — scale them to your model's own extent. Names describe density intent only, never a mesh-quality guarantee.

balanced.name: balanced
balanced.description: Everyday Gmsh tetrahedral mesh at a 1 mm target size. Sizes are absolute — scale them to your model's own extent. Names describe density intent only, never a mesh-quality guarantee.

fine-detail.name: fine-detail
fine-detail.description: Dense Gmsh tetrahedral mesh at a 0.25 mm target size, for small features. Expect a large element count on bigger models. Sizes are absolute — scale them to your model's own extent. Names describe density intent only, never a mesh-quality guarantee.

robust-repair.name: robust-repair
robust-repair.description: fTetWild tetrahedral mesh from the mesh's own bbox-derived sizing — for dirty triangle soups (holes, self-intersections) the Gmsh path cannot classify. Gmsh-only fields such as element order have no effect under this engine.
